headline: 亨利・屈瑞吉三重奏新輯
context: 82歲的普立茲獎得主亨利・屈瑞吉（Henry Threadgill），與鋼琴家維傑・艾爾（Vijay Iyer）、打擊樂手達夫尼斯・普利耶托（Dafnis Prieto）組成三重奏，發行新專輯《Fifteen》。樂評形容這張專輯精彩，展現三人深厚的即興默契。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Nonesuch) By turns gleeful, sensitive, urgent and ruminative, this is a brilliant set that plays to the trio’s formidable strengths Though the century-old Pulitzer prize – launched as a celebration of the craft and social necessity of good news reportage – was eventually expanded to include fiction and music by 1943, the US-born art of jazz has only been represented by Ornette Coleman and Wynton Marsalis in their lifetimes, Duke Ellington, John Coltrane and Thelonious Monk posthumously – and most recently Henry Threadgill , for his four-part suite In for a Penny, In for a Pound , in 2016. Publisher Joseph Pulitzer once declared his dreams for his readership were “to arrest their attention, enlist their sympathy … stimulate their imagination, convince their reason, and awaken their conscience”. Contemporary-classical composer and flautist Threadgill has been doing all that with his music, his personal story , his internationalism and his charisma since the 1960s. Now 82, he releases Fifteen, joining him in a brilliant trio featuring pianist/composer Vijay Iyer and creative Cuban percussionist Dafnis Prieto. Continue reading...
sources.title: Henry Threadgill, Vijay Iyer, Dafnis Prieto: Fifteen review – Pulitzer winner stirs gorgeous improv patterns

thread_text:
82歲的普立茲獎得主亨利・屈瑞吉（Henry Threadgill），與鋼琴家維傑・艾爾（Vijay Iyer）、打擊樂手達夫尼斯・普利耶托（Dafnis Prieto）組成三重奏，發行新專輯《Fifteen》。

樂評形容這張專輯精彩，充分展現三人深厚的即興默契。爵士樂在普立茲獎歷史上並不常見得獎——屈瑞吉是繼歐涅・柯曼、溫頓・馬沙利斯之後，少數在世時就獲獎的爵士音樂家。

目前這則消息只有 The Guardian 一家報導，細節有限。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 14 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 普立茲獎得主屈瑞吉，發了新專輯。82歲的亨利・屈瑞吉（Henry Threadgill），這次和鋼琴家維傑・艾爾、打擊樂手達夫尼斯・普利耶托組成三重奏，推出新作《Fifteen》。樂評說這張專輯相當精彩，展現三人深厚的即興默契。爵士樂在普立茲獎歷史上不常得獎——屈瑞吉是繼歐涅・柯曼、溫頓・馬沙利斯之後，少數在世時就獲獎的爵士音樂家。目前的消息細節還有限。
